Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
WHEN a pending points transaction is 24 hours old and the purchase was not returned, the loyalty service shall post the points to the member's balance.
Rationale: The 24-hour return window protects against points on returned goods.

Text: WHEN the member opens the balance screen, the customer mobile app shall display the posted points balance.
Rationale: Members check their balance after paying.

Text: The loyalty service shall expire posted points 12 months after posting.
Rationale: Limits the points liability on the balance sheet (SH-03).

Text: The loyalty service shall expire posted points 18 months after posting.
Rationale: Occasional shoppers lose points before they reach the redemption minimum.

Text: The loyalty service shall retain points transaction records for 7 years after the transaction date.
WHEN a member closes their account, the loyalty service shall delete the member's personal data within 30 days.
Rationale: Personal data must not be kept longer than needed.
